messages:
megan: Heads-up — CI is failing on a bunch of docs anchors after the markdown-it upgrade in docs-build. Failing job: https://ci.redwood.ai/runner/9023/logs/12345. It looks like slug normalization changed and table headers + code fences now produce different anchors. Anyone owning runtime-guide/* or onboarding/*? Can we either pin markdown-it to 13.1.0 in the pipeline or patch affected frontmatter quickly?

sanjay: I can take the pin for now. Will open a quick PR to lock the dependency and add a smoke test for anchor stability.

alex: I think the new plugin turned on `slugify: lodash` behavior — small change. Long-term we should add an anchor test harness, but pinning is fine short-term.

megan: Thanks @sanjay. If you open the PR please add a note about which pages were failing (runtime-guide/ops.md, onboarding/getting-started.md) so we can audit.

sanjay: Opening PR now. Diff pins markdown-it in package.json and adds a tiny test script that runs `npm run build && node scripts/check-anchors.js` to assert anchors haven't regressed. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/789

docs-bot: CI failed for build on commit 8a7f3c2 — see https://ci.redwood.ai/runner/9023/logs/12345

carla: Would you also add me as owner on runtime-guide/ops.md? I can follow up with content tweaks if the anchors change.

sanjay: Done — added @carla to frontmatter and updated PR description. Keeping the test minimal so it doesn't flap.

alex: Quick code-review: the test script uses a naive regex, can you scope it to headings only? Otherwise LGTM.

sanjay: Updated test per @alex suggestion. Rerunning CI.

docs-bot: CI succeeded on PR 789 (checks passed) — merge queued.

megan: Awesome. Once merged can someone run the redirect checker sweep? There were a handful of external shortlinks that also tripped.

carla: I can run the sweep in the morning and file follow-ups if anything else breaks.

megan: Perfect. Thanks all :heart:
